resources.string: App lock is optional. Private messages, attachments, drafts and preferences stay encrypted in either mode. With app lock off, the app can use its key without another credential prompt; rely on your device\'s access controls. Shared Android messages remain in their existing storage. Carrier SMS/MMS is not end-to-end encrypted.

Optional private SMS/MMS storage and optional app lock. New traffic uses Android storage unless Private message storage is enabled. Keystore keys are generated on this device and are not embedded in the APK. No backups, accounts or analytics. Carrier SMS/MMS is not end-to-end encrypted. Existing shared SMS/MMS and earlier private messages stay visible in either mode. Turning private storage off does not export earlier private data. Shared originals stay in Android storage unless you explicitly move or delete them.

WARNING: Enabling this removes new incoming and outgoing SMS/MMS from Android\'s shared message store after the private encrypted copy is verified. These messages are then managed solely by SimpleSMS and will not be available to other SMS apps. Clearing app data, uninstalling, or losing the encryption key can permanently lose them. Existing history is not moved by this switch.
